scenes.heading: Understanding your target audience before creating content

sents.d: Understanding your target audience before creating content
Content built around a vague audience usually converts poorly.

scenes.heading: Content for everyone reaches no one

sents.d: Content created for 'everyone' typically resonates with no one — knowing specifically who you're trying to reach shapes tone, platform choice, and topic selection far more than most people expect.

A simple customer profile — their main frustration, what they've already tried, what would make them trust a new provider — gives you a filter for every piece of content: does this speak directly to that person's situation?

Talking directly to a handful of past or ideal customers, even informally, usually reveals language and pain points more accurate than guessing internally, and that language often becomes your best-performing headlines and hooks.

take: Know exactly who you're talking to before you create.
